title: lodhra crataegoides
intro: Lodhra crataegoides, commonly known as Symplocos racemosa, is a deciduous tree species native to the Himalayan region. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Ayurvedic and Unani medicine. The health benefits of Lodhra crataegoides include its ability to treat menstrual disorders, menopausal symptoms, and uterine infections, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-estrogenic properties. The bioactive constituents of Lodhra crataegoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
